news.title: Academic Calendar & Assessment Schedule Announcement
news.content: The Academic Office has updated the training and assessment schedule to allow sufficient time for clinical practical evaluation and continuous assessment review.

news.title: Caregiver & Nurse Assistant Clinical Practical Intake
news.content: Admissions are open for upcoming certificate cohorts in Caregiver, Nurse Assistant, and Homecare Assistant. Practical clinical training attachments commence following core module completion.

news.title: Clinical Module Coursework & Handout Submissions
news.content: All instructors and trainees are reminded that the portal for uploading supplementary clinical handouts and practical evaluation logs is active. Ensure submissions are updated on schedule.

courses.title: Certificate in Caregiver
courses.description: Comprehensive practical training covering patient care foundations, vital signs monitoring, geriatric assistance, and supportive healthcare delivery.

courses.title: Certificate in Nurse Assistant
courses.description: Practical clinical fundamentals, patient care support, infection control, and hospital ward assistance procedures under professional clinical supervision.

courses.title: Certificate in Homecare Assistant
courses.description: Specialized training for in-home patient assistance, personal care, chronic disease management support, and home-based clinical rehabilitation.

testimonies.name: Erick Cheruiyot
testimonies.content: The hands-on practical clinical training at Alika Medical provided comprehensive patient care and vital signs skills that prepared me thoroughly for bedside and homecare assistance.

testimonies.name: Tabitha Kamau
testimonies.content: Alika Medical trainees demonstrate strong foundational discipline in infection prevention, empathetic patient communication, and vital signs monitoring.
